@notificationsTitle.description: Title of the notifications page and of its empty state.

@notificationsTabAll.description: Filter tab: every notification. Tabs sit side by side: keep them short.

@notificationsTabReplies.description: Filter tab (and title of its empty state): replies. Keep it short.

@notificationsTabComments.description: Filter tab (and title of its empty state): comments on the user's capsules. Keep it short.

notificationsEmptyAll: Your notifications and activity will appear here
notificationsEmptyReplies: Replies to your messages will appear here
notificationsEmptyComments: Comments on your Capsules will appear here

@notificationsTypeFollow.description: Title of a notification of this type.

@notificationsFollowBody.description: Notification text; the name is shown in bold. The name cannot be inflected: phrase it so the name stays in its base form.

@notificationsCapsuleBody.description: Notification text: a friend created a capsule. The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsMessageBody.description: Notification text: a chat message. The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsCommentBody.description: Notification text: a comment on the user's capsule (no comment text stored). The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsCommentBodyWithText.description: Notification text: a comment on the user's capsule, followed by the comment itself. The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsReplyBody.description: Notification text: a reply to the user (no reply text stored). The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsReplyBodyWithText.description: Notification text: a reply to the user, followed by the reply itself. The name is bold and cannot be inflected.

@notificationsJustNow.description: Time of a notification less than a minute old.

@notificationsMinutesAgo.description: Time of a notification less than an hour old (English abbreviates; write it the way your language shows recent times).

@notificationsHoursAgo.description: Time of a notification less than a day old.

@notificationsDaysAgo.description: Time of a notification less than a week old; older ones show the date.

@notificationsSelectedCount.description: Selection bar: how many notifications are selected. Starts with the number, which is shown large and bold.

@notificationsMarkAsRead.description: Accessibility label of the selection bar button that marks the selected notifications as read.

notificationsMarkedRead: {count, plural, one{{count} notification marked as read} other{{count} notifications marked as read}}

@notificationsMarkedRead.description: Toast after marking the selected notifications as read.

@notificationsDeleteConfirm.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting the selected notifications.

notificationsDeleted: {count, plural, one{{count} notification deleted} other{{count} notifications deleted}}

@notificationsDeleted.description: Toast after the selected notifications were deleted.

notificationsUnreadBadge: {count, plural, one{{count} unread notification} other{{count} unread notifications}}

@notificationsUnreadBadge.description: Accessibility label of the red badge on the notifications bell.

@notificationsAchievementBody.description: {name} is the app's name (Later), shown in bold.

notificationsChannelMessagesSilentDescri: New messages, without sound or vibration
notificationsChannelActivityDescription: Followers, friend requests, reactions, comments and new capsules

@notificationsTypeCoAuthor.description: Title of a notification: a friend made a capsule with the user (co-author).

@notificationsCoAuthorBody.description: Notification: a friend added the user as a co-author of a new capsule.

@notificationsChannelMessagesNoVibration.description: Android notification channel name: messages with sound, without vibration.

@notificationsChannelActivityNoVibration.description: Android notification channel name: activity with sound, without vibration.

@notificationsFromLater.description: Label of an announcement in the notifications list.

@notificationsSwipeRead.description: Shown behind a notification swiped right: it becomes read.

@notificationsSwipeDelete.description: Shown behind a notification swiped left: it is deleted.

@notificationsNowFriends.description: Under a friend request notification once accepted.
